description.zh:
物模型自定义模块标识符，在产品中具有唯一性。

不传入此参数时，查询默认模块数据。
description.en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes](~~87387~~).

><notice>

description.en:
The ProductKey of the product.

You can view the ProductKey on the Product Details page of the IoT Platform console. You can also obtain the ProductKey by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.

description.zh:
要查询的物模型版本号。

不传入此参数，则将返回未发布上线的草稿版物模型TSL。
description.en:
Specifies whether to retrieve a simplified TSL model.

*   **true**: retrieves a simplified TSL model.

    A simplified TSL model includes only the **identifier** and **dataType** attributes of properties, services, events, and related input or output parameters. Simplified TSL models can be used by device developers for reference.

*   **false**: retrieves the complete TSL model.

    A complete TSL model includes all the parameters and values of properties, services, and events. Complete TSL models can be used by cloud application developers for reference.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
产品的ProductKey。
可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看，或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)查看ProductKey的取值。
description.en:
The version number of the TSL model to be queried.

If you do not specify this parameter, IoT Platform returns the draft TSL model that is unpublished.

description.zh:
是否获取精简版物模型信息。

- **true**：获取精简版物模型TSL。

    精简版物模型TSL中仅包含属性、服务、事件及入参和出参的标识符（**identifier**）和数据类型（**dataType**），可供设备端开发人员参考。

- **false**：获取完整的物模型TSL。

    完整物模型TSL中包含属性、服务和事件定义的所有参数和取值，可供云端应用开发人员参考。

不传入此参数，则默认为false，获取完整的物模型信息。
description.en:
The identifier of the custom TSL module. Each identifier is unique in a product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default module is queried.

title.zh: 查询指定产品的物模型TSL
title.en: Query the TSL Model of a Specified Product

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。
 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit  
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send up to 20 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot get-thing-model-tsl --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --model-version v1.0.0 --simple true --function-block-id BatteryModule --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot GetThingModelTsl --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ModelVersion 'v1.0.0' --FunctionBlockId BatteryModule --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --Simple true
